resources.string:
This app watches incoming SMS/messaging notifications (Messages, WhatsApp, Gmail) on this device and, when one contains an OTP or verification code, replaces it with a redacted version so the code doesn\'t sit visible in your notification shade.
This requires \"Notification access\", which Android requires you to grant manually in Settings (tap the button below). Note: Android does not let this app rewrite another app\'s notification directly - it works by removing the original and posting its own redacted replacement, so there can be a brief moment before the original is replaced.
